        n = len(sub_arr)
        changes = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]

        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if sub_arr[i] == sub_arr[j]:
                    changes[i][j] = changes[i + 1][j - 1]
                else:
                    changes[i][j] = 1 + min(changes[i + 1][j], changes[i][j - 1])

        return changes[0][n - 1]

    if n == 0:
        return 0

    middle = n // 2
    changes_needed = 0

    for i in range(middle):
        changes_needed += count_changes(arr[i], arr[n - 1 - i])

    return min_changes_to_palindrome(arr)
